headline: Anthropic releases FlashProve, a zero-knowledge proof prototype for model inference
summary: Anthropic announced FlashProve, an open-source zero-knowledge proof prototype intended to let a verifier check that inference used a committed model without seeing its weights. Its Nov 2 post reports about 110 proof tokens per second for 4-bit Llama 4 Maverick on one H100, with proofs around 19 MB per 1,024-token request and GPU time 70–95 times ordinary vLLM inference. These are first-party prototype results; independent performance and security review has not been established.
